requirements.text: Customers can register and sign in with email or phone
requirements.exact_quote: Let customers order groceries online and choose a delivery slot.

requirements.text: Customers can browse the product catalogue and search by name
requirements.exact_quote: I want to search for what I need and put it in a basket.

requirements.text: Customers can place an order and choose a delivery slot
requirements.exact_quote: At checkout I want to pick a delivery slot.

requirements.text: Customers can pay online by card or cash on delivery
requirements.exact_quote: I can pay by card online or cash when the order arrives.

requirements.text: Customers see order status updates from accepted to delivered
requirements.exact_quote: Customers must see the order status: accepted, packed, out for delivery and delivered.

requirements.text: The manager can add, edit and remove products and stock levels
requirements.exact_quote: I need to add new products and change the stock every morning.

requirements.text: The manager can see a daily orders dashboard
requirements.exact_quote: only the manager can change products or see the daily numbers.

requirements.text: Customer and payment data are protected; card data is never stored on our servers
requirements.exact_quote: Payment data must not be stored on our servers, and only the manager can change products.

stories.text: As a new customer I can register and sign in with my email or phone number
acceptance_criteria: A new account is created with a valid email or phone.
Signing in with wrong credentials shows an error.

stories.text: As a customer I can browse the catalogue and search for a product by name
acceptance_criteria: The catalogue lists products by category.
Searching by name returns matching products.

stories.text: As a customer I can place an order and choose a delivery slot
acceptance_criteria: An order can be placed from the cart.
Only available delivery slots can be selected.

stories.text: As a customer I can pay by card online or choose cash on delivery
acceptance_criteria: A card payment is confirmed before the order is accepted.
Cash on delivery orders are marked as unpaid.

stories.text: As a customer I can see the status of my order until it is delivered
acceptance_criteria: Each status change is visible on the order.
The order ends in the delivered status.

stories.text: As a store manager I can add, edit and remove products and stock levels
acceptance_criteria: A product can be created and edited.
Out-of-stock products are hidden from customers.

stories.text: As a store manager I can see a daily orders dashboard
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard shows today's order totals.
Pending orders are listed with their status.

stories.text: As the platform owner I ensure card data is never stored and access is role-based
acceptance_criteria: No card number is stored in the database.
Only the manager can change products.
